gates.name: closed_content_envelopes
gates.evidence: Provider, tool, document and memory envelopes require exact origin-specific trust, tenant, data-class and DATA_ONLY instruction-eligibility labels; missing, unknown, mismatched, duplicate and cross-tenant inputs deny.

gates.name: typed_candidate_reconstruction
gates.evidence: A closed model-shaped candidate can name only one finite catalogue action, bounded symbolic arguments and the complete evidence set; trusted code alone reconstructs exact method, path, scope, replay binding and stable digests.

gates.name: opaque_secret_and_authority_boundary
gates.evidence: Only fixed server-owned opaque credential handles appear; candidate-supplied method, path, URL, headers, secret, handle, authority, approval, outcome, replay, tenant, provider or scope fields deny without a partial action.

gates.name: hostile_channel_regression_evidence
gates.evidence: Override, exfiltration, self-approval, URL, path, base64, percent-encoded, Unicode-confusable, bidi, zero-width and multi-turn payloads across all four origins changed evidence digests only; action/candidate digests and exact reconstructed calls stayed unchanged.

fullInstallSmoke.reason: AAS-009 adds a pure TypeScript contract, tests and documentation only; no demo runtime, installer, Compose, provider adapter or install-path byte changed. The prior AAS-003 smoke budget therefore remains frozen and a repeat would not add relevant evidence.

nonClaims: No live model, tokenizer, retrieval stack, reviewed model gateway, production credential broker or production tenant boundary was tested or enabled.
No claim that prompt injection is eliminated; the evidence proves only local closed-schema non-interference for the tested provider-neutral contract and fixtures.
A reconstructed candidate is not a Policy decision, Approval, executable authority or provider call.
No push, pull request, merge, tag, release, publication, production deployment or external-system action.
